messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Pinegrove (analytics platform) flagged an orgwide adoption signal. Sales says 3 new dev squads + QA team want embeddings + realtime summarization. Trial env qps jumped from ~150/day -> ~1.8k/day overnight. Need capacity plan + enablement.

tim_se: Nice. Do they want Dedicated or Hosted for the ramp? Jordan mentioned hosted eval first, but they may request Dedicated within ~60 days if latency/SLA checks out.

lisa_pm: Renewal for them is Oct 3 — if they shift to Dedicated we need to lock pricing and contract clauses. Reps also flagged per-team routing + workspace isolation as feature asks. Renewal risk moves from green -> watch.

kena_support: I pulled their logs. Most errors are 429s hitting /v1/chat when concurrency > 12. I can bump autoscale config and add caching headers. Any specific prompt templates we should share to reduce token churn?

tim_se: Share our batching + prefix-caching playbook. I'll draft a 1-pager playbook for dev squads with examples: `curl` snippets, recommended 2-5s timeouts, and batching config. Propose a canary: route non-urgent summarization to a quantized model variant to save cost.

maria_cs: :thumbsup: Also need a quick ballpark cost delta for sales — they want an estimate if they hit sustained 2k qps at peak.

ops_bot: Estimate job queued. Rough calc: 2k qps sustained peak -> ~50M tokens/day (very rough). Hosted monthly delta depends on model family; flagging infra for Dedicated sizing. Ops/Eng, please confirm GPU pool sizing and cost.

lisa_pm: Let's sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. Attendees: Tim (SE), Maria (CS), Kena (Support), Jordan (Sales), Ops rep. Action items: 1) Tim: playbook draft, 2) Kena: mitigation + autoscale tweak, 3) Ops: capacity + cost calc, 4) Maria: update renewal risk to 'watch' and capture enablement ask.

jordan_sales: On it — I'll confirm exact squads, expected go-live dates, and whether any data residency/VPC reqs. Sales expects two squads to go live in 3 weeks, third squad in ~8 weeks.

maria_cs: I'll open a trial-support ticket and tag #eng-runtime if we need kernel-level tweaks. Also capturing feedback: they want better per-route cost visibility in the console.

tim_se: Noted. I'll include console screenshots and a runbook: how to interpret per-route token breakdown and set per-route quotas.

kena_support: Patch deployed to increase 429 backoff/backpressure on Pinegrove account. Monitoring panels in Grafana show reduced error spikes so far. Will report back after 24-48h.

maria_cs: :white_check_mark: Great — if throughput stabilizes after 48h we can propose a 30-day Dedicated pilot and an SLA/cost proposal for the renewal. I'll update the account health doc and ping legal for early-term pricing language.

ops_bot: Added a follow-up reminder for Oct 1 to revisit renewal terms and finalize pilot sizing.

maria_cs: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source for coordination. If anyone hears timeline changes ping here or drop in the 10am sync invite.
